origin.description: Get the options used by Rd2txt.

arguments.text: Named options to set. Empty returns the current options.

origin.details: The defaults are width 80, minIndent 10, extraIndent 4, sectionIndent 5, sectionExtra 2, a bullet, showURLs FALSE, code_quote TRUE, and underline_titles TRUE.
origin.value: The option list. Invisibly, the previous values when setting.

translation.description: Get the options used by Rd2txt.

arguments.text: Named options to set. Empty returns the current options.

translation.details: Returns those defaults. enumFormat(n) is n followed by a period and a space.
